translations.web: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
translations.bsb: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
translations.kjv: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
